Class SysMLConstraint

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.constraint.SysMLConstraint
Direct Known Subclasses:
SysMLGuard, SysMLRequirement
public class SysMLConstraint extends SysMLOccurrence
SysMLinJava representation of the SysML constraint. SysMLConstraint is an occurrence with an optional function and text that define a constraint on a model element. The constraint function is a functional interface specification that is an extension of the ConstraintFunction interface. The text is a documenation that contains the function code and/or specifies the constraint in plain text.

The SysMLConstraint should be declared as a field in the extended SysMLPart, SysMLPort, SysMLAction, SysMLItem, or collection SysMLRequirementsCollection, SysMLViewpointsCollection, etc. class. The field should be annotated with the Constraint annotation. It should then created/initialized with an object creation expression either as part of the field declaration or in the override of the SysMLPart, SysMLPort, SysMLAction, or SysMLItem class's createConstraints() method. An example is as follows: 

	public MyPart extends SysMLPart
	{
     &#64;Attribute
     protected PowerWatts powerIn;
     &#64;Attribute
     protected HeatWatts heatOut;
     &#64;Attribute
     protected Percent mechanical;
         :
		&#64;FunctionalInterface
		public interface PercentMechanicalFunction extends SysMLConstraintFunction
		{
			Percent percentMechanical(PowerWatts powerIn, HeatWatts heatOut);
		}
         :
     &#64;ConstraintFunction
     protected SysMLConstraintFunction firstConstraintFunction;

     &#64;Constraint
     protected SysMLConstraint firstConstraint;

     &#64;Override
     protected void createConstraintFunctions()
     {
         firstConstraint = (PercentMechanicalFunction)(powerIn, heatOut) ->
         {
         	return new Percent(powerIn.subtracted(heatOut).dividedBy(powerIn));
         });
     }

     &#64;Override
     protected void createConstraints()
     {
         firstConstraint = new SysMLConstraint(Optional.of(firstConstraintFunction), "mechanical percent = powerIn - heatOut / powerIn", "percentMechanicla", 0L);
     }
    }

  • Field Details

    • function

      @ConstraintFunction public Optional<? extends SysMLConstraintFunction> function
      Optional function to specify the constraint, i.e. instance of an extension of the (@code SysMLConstraintFunction} interface that is created (as a Lambda function), usually in the scope/context of the model element in which it will execute. This definition of the constraint is an alternative is to defining as simple text in text variable.

      Note that some model views can only display constraints as text, in which case it may be desirable to duplicate the code assigned to the function variable as simple text in the text variable to enable its display by these views.

    • text

      @ConstraintText public SysMLDocumentation text
      Documentation text to specify the constraint, i.e. instance of (@code SysMLDocumentation} that contains a textual representation of the constraint. This documentation of the constraint may be an alternative way of defining the formal lambda function in function variable and/or simply be an informal text-based specification of the constraint.

      Constructor for specified function and occurence
      Parameters:
      function - optional name of instance of executable lambda function that defines the executable constraint, i.e. instance of the java code for a lambda function for a functional interface that extends the SysMLConstraintFunction interface.
      text - documentation that specifies the constraint as free-form text.
      name - unique name for the constraint
      id - unique identifier of the constraint

  • Method Details

    • satisfied

      protected boolean satisfied()
      Overridable method to execute the constraint to determine satisfac. This method may be overridden in lieu of defining the @function, i.e. the BasicConstraintFunction for the constraint. The default method is to invoke the function if it has been assigned a value of type ConstraintFunction, presumably in an override of the createFunction() method.

      Note this method is provided to enable model execution. It is not part of the SysML standard, To the extent the SysML standard does not provide elements for executable modeling per se, SysMLinJava includes various model elements to enable model execution.

      Returns:
      constraint result

    • createAttributes

      protected void createAttributes()
      Creates the attributes, if any, that are used in specifying the constraint.This method is invoked in an extended type of SysMLConstraint. An example follows. 
      	public class SWAPConstraint extends SysMLConstraint
	{
			:
		&#64;Attribute
		PowerWatts maxPowerIn;
		&#64;Attribute
		HeatWatts minHeatOut;
			:

		&#64;Override
		protected void createAttributes()
		{
			maxPowerIn = new PowerWatts(1500);
			minHeatOut = new HeatWatts(1500);
		}
			:
		&#64;Override
		protected void createFunction
		{
			function = Optional.of((BasicConstraintFunction)() -> minHeatOut.greaterThan(maxPowerIn));
		}
	}

    • createFunction

      protected void createFunction()
      Overridable operation that creates the constraint's function, i.e. an executable lambda function that resolves the constraint. This method is invoked in an extended type of SysMLConstraint. It initializes the function as executable code that performs the constraint. The method must consist of a statement that assigns the executable code as a lambda function to the function variable. The lambda function must be type-cast to the functional interface that defines the constraint in terms of its inputs and output. An example follows. 
      	public class PlotConstraint extends SysMLConstraint
	{
		&#64;Attribute
		IInteger x;
		&#64;Attribute
		IInteger y;

		&#64;FunctionalInterface
		public interface MyConstraintFunction extends SysMLConstraintFunction
		{
			int getY(int x);
		}


		&#64;Override
		public void createAttributes()
		{
			x = 25;
			y = 10;
		}

		&#64;Override
		public void createFunction()
		{
			function = Optional.of(MyConstraintFunction)(x) ->
			{
				int y = 10 * x.value + 25;
				return y;
			};
		}
	}

      protected void createText()
      Overridable operation that creates the (sub)constraint as a simple text document. This method is invoked in an extended type of SysMLConstraint. It creates the text variable and initializes it with a simple textual representation of the constraint. An example follows. 
      	{
			:
		&#64;ConstraintText
		SysMLDocumentation text;
			:
		public void createText()
		{
			text = new SysMLDocumentation("minimum heat shall be less than maximum power"));
		}
			:
	}
